# Knights of the Royal Oak

> > A modern chivalric order founded in honor of King Charles II, connecting members worldwide through heritage, heraldry, genealogy, and charitable service.

The Knights of the Royal Oak (KRO) is a membership organization with knights and dames across the UK, Australia, Europe, and beyond. Members hold baronial titles, engage in charity work including homeless support and food banks, and share interests in heraldry, genealogy, and British heritage.

## Key Topics

- Knights of the Royal Oak (KRO)
- Chivalric order and knighthood
- King Charles II heritage
- Heraldry and coat of arms
- Genealogy and family history
- Baronial titles (Baron, Lord, Lady)
- Charity work and community service
- Membership benefits and application
- Knight Roll (member directory)
- International membership (UK, Australia, Europe)
- Grand Master Kevin Charles Norris
- Heritage preservation
- Social networking for knights
- Member biographies and profiles

- [Membership Application Form](https://kro.org.uk/membership-application-form): Application form to join Knights of the Royal Oak membership
- [Benefits of Becoming a Knight](https://kro.org.uk/benefits-of-becoming-a-knight): Membership benefits including heritage, social network, and charity support
- [Charity Work](https://kro.org.uk/charity-work): Member charity initiatives: homeless support, food banks, animal welfare
